Title: PRE-FLIGHT -- Returns And Push Messages Modules, Return And Notification Settings, return-attachments Upload Scope (Suite BLOCKED, Not FAIL, When Missing)
Preconditions:
Runner-native. No browser. Nothing is created except one unattached probe file.
ENVIRONMENT REQUIRED BY THIS SUITE (a miss makes the suite - or, where named, only the cases that need it - BLOCKED, never FAIL):
(1) Module VirtoCommerce.Return installed (GET /api/platform/modules, isInstalled=true).
(2) Module VirtoCommerce.PushMessages installed - needed ONLY by the push assertions (pushMessages query, push counts, push text); the email assertions do not need it (the module sends email-only when it is absent).
(3) Store {{STORE_ID}} Settings > Return > Return: "Return module" (Return.ReturnEnabled) = ON; "Order statuses allowing returns" (Return.AllowedOrderStatuses) contains Completed; "Photos or documents required" (Return.AttachmentsRequired) = ON (the buyer-side setup steps attach one file per line); "Return reasons" (Return.Reasons) contains NoLongerNeeded.
(4) Store {{STORE_ID}} Settings > Return > Notifications: "Return email notifications" (Return.SendNotifications) = ON and "Return push notifications" (Return.SendPushNotifications) = ON (both default ON; RET-AUTH-015 flips and restores them).
(5) Platform configuration FileUpload:Scopes includes return-attachments.
(6) Permission return:authorize ("Approve and decline returns") held by {{ADMIN}} (an administrator holds it); NO stock role holds it - the restricted user RETURNS_AGENT_NO_AUTHORIZE (seed:backoffice-rbac) is the negative actor.
(7) Fixtures: npm run seed:returns:decisions (RETURNS_AUTH_*) re-seeded BEFORE each run, because a decided return is terminal and approved units stay held; verify with npm run returns:decisions:check. Buyer {{USER_EMAIL}}, colleague {{USER2_EMAIL}} in the same organization.
(8) Email delivery is NOT required: SMTP may answer 535 and every message then ends in status Error - the notification journal record (type, recipient, subject, body, language) is the evidence, never delivery.

[AUTH role=ADMIN_DEFAULT]
[REST-OP modules]
GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/modules
[REST-EXEC modules]
[REST-OP settings]
GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/settings/v2/tenant/Store/{{store}}/values
[REST-EXEC settings]
[AUTH role=USER]

query { pushMessages(first: 1) { totalCount } }

Content-Type: multipart/form-data

Team decision (VCST-5883, observed live on vcptcore-qa1): the PRICE of a decided line is editable in the Admin blade and Save persists it - it is not a decision field. The storefront xAPI exposes no return price (the xAPI return types carry no price field), so the edit is invisible to the buyer. The case restores the captured original price in its last step so the fixture is left as found. 1.23 is a chosen input (never asserted against a stored value other than itself).
Every line object of the full-body PUT carries its returnId (a line without it is treated as a new line: the old one is deleted and a new id issued). A null field is never captured (the runner forces INVALID on a null capture): measureUnit is OBSERVED null for this unit-less product and is sent as a literal null.
ENVIRONMENT REQUIRED BY THIS SUITE (a miss makes the suite - or, where named, only the cases that need it - BLOCKED, never FAIL):
(1) Module VirtoCommerce.Return installed (GET /api/platform/modules, isInstalled=true).
(2) Module VirtoCommerce.PushMessages installed - needed ONLY by the push assertions (pushMessages query, push counts, push text); the email assertions do not need it (the module sends email-only when it is absent).
(3) Store {{STORE_ID}} Settings > Return > Return: "Return module" (Return.ReturnEnabled) = ON; "Order statuses allowing returns" (Return.AllowedOrderStatuses) contains Completed; "Photos or documents required" (Return.AttachmentsRequired) = ON (the buyer-side setup steps attach one file per line); "Return reasons" (Return.Reasons) contains NoLongerNeeded.
(4) Store {{STORE_ID}} Settings > Return > Notifications: "Return email notifications" (Return.SendNotifications) = ON and "Return push notifications" (Return.SendPushNotifications) = ON (both default ON; RET-AUTH-015 flips and restores them).
(5) Platform configuration FileUpload:Scopes includes return-attachments.
(6) Permission return:authorize ("Approve and decline returns") held by {{ADMIN}} (an administrator holds it); NO stock role holds it - the restricted user RETURNS_AGENT_NO_AUTHORIZE (seed:backoffice-rbac) is the negative actor.
(7) Fixtures: npm run seed:returns:decisions (RETURNS_AUTH_*) re-seeded BEFORE each run, because a decided return is terminal and approved units stay held; verify with npm run returns:decisions:check. Buyer {{USER_EMAIL}}, colleague {{USER2_EMAIL}} in the same organization.
(8) Email delivery is NOT required: SMTP may answer 535 and every message then ends in status Error - the notification journal record (type, recipient, subject, body, language) is the evidence, never delivery.

Title: Organization copy ON — each of the five return emails is also sent once to the organization's address, push stays with the buyer
Preconditions: Runner-native. No browser. BS-PRE applies: (1) NO REAL MAILBOX: every address in this case is an AGENT-TEST yopmail address (the buyer email goes to the ORDER's address email, which the 3a fixtures set to the account address; yopmail inboxes are PUBLIC, nothing but test content). (2) Return.NotifyOrganizationEmail on B2B-store is a SHARED setting: while it is ON, RET-AUTH-009 and RET-AUTH-028..031 of this suite (and any parallel run) fail "exactly one email". This case turns it ON, so it runs ALONE in its own window, never beside another lane that submits returns, and restores the originals at the end and in Cleanup. READ BEFORE CHANGE: the case GETs the store settings first (settings_before, kept as evidence). The runner path grammar cannot address a dotted settings key (getByPath splits the path on every dot, so a capture of Return.NotifyOrganizationEmail is not expressible), so the originals are the DECLARED EFFECTIVE values in Test_Data (orig_notify_org=false, orig_send=true, as observed on vcst 2026-10-08) and the restore writes those variables back explicitly: the store settings API IGNORES value:null, so a setting stored as null can only be restored to its EFFECTIVE value written explicitly. If the effective original on another stand differs, change the two Test_Data values before running. ALONE: no other lane or suite may submit returns while the setting is ON, and the case runs AFTER the "exactly one email" seam rows RET-AUTH-009 and RET-AUTH-028..031 (they are only true while the setting is OFF), never beside them. (3) Evidence is the notification journal, not delivery: SMTP may be absent (status Error is still inspectable). The journal recipient field is read as `to`; the first live run settles the field name. Return.AttachmentsRequired must be at its default false (else the submit step is BLOCKED, KB-84773559). The org-copy field names and the Hangfire delay are observed, not documented: a copy is searched for after a fixed wait. The case drives SIX returns of ORG_RET_BUYER (order lines A and B), all inside one ON window: R1 submit then Approved; R2 (two lines) submit then PartiallyApproved; R3 submit then Rejected; R4 submit then cancelled after submit; D5 a draft cancelled before submit. The decisions go through POST /api/return/{id}/authorize as the administrator. Each return is read from its OWN journal, so counts are per return, never totals. Approved and PartiallyApproved returns keep their units held for good (no un-authorize): the case permanently consumes two units of line A per run (40 ordered); re-seed with npm run seed:returns:org -- --fresh when they run low. The ON window is the whole case: other lanes must not submit returns while it runs. The Registered push is asserted only on R1 and needs the Push Messages module (else those two lines are BLOCKED).
Test_Data: orig_notify_org=false; orig_send=true; order=@td(ORG_RET_BUYER.orderId); la=@td(ORG_RET_BUYER.lineAItemId); lb=@td(ORG_RET_BUYER.lineBItemId); buyer_email=@td(ORG_RET_BUYER.email); org_email=@td(ORG_RET_VIEWER_ORG.email)
